pois.name: Robertson Quay
pois.description: Scenic riverside neighbourhood with pedestrian paths, restaurants, and bars along the Singapore River.

pois.name: Gardens by the Bay
pois.description: Futuristic nature park featuring Cloud Forest, Flower Dome, and the iconic Supertree Grove.

pois.name: Supertree Grove
pois.description: Vertical gardens up to 50m tall with a skyway walkway. Garden Rhapsody light show at 19:45 and 20:45.

pois.name: Marina Bay Sands
pois.description: Iconic hotel with rooftop observation deck offering panoramic views of the city skyline.

pois.name: ArtScience Museum
pois.description: Lotus-shaped museum with interactive digital art exhibitions. Great for kids.

pois.name: Maxwell Food Centre
pois.description: Historic hawker centre with dozens of local food stalls. Home of the famous Tian Tian chicken rice.

pois.name: Lau Pa Sat
pois.description: Victorian cast-iron hawker centre in the CBD. Satay street opens in the evening.

pois.name: Sentosa Island
pois.description: Resort island with beaches, Universal Studios, S.E.A. Aquarium, and cable car rides.

pois.name: Singapore Zoo & Night Safari
pois.description: World-class open-concept zoo. Night Safari opens at 18:15 — the world's first nocturnal zoo.

pois.name: Orchard Road
pois.description: Singapore's premier shopping boulevard with malls, department stores, and street food.

pois.name: Chinatown
pois.description: Historic district with temples, street markets, and traditional shophouses.

pois.name: Changi Airport
pois.description: Award-winning airport with Jewel Changi indoor waterfall and gardens.

pois.name: Singapore Botanic Gardens
pois.description: UNESCO World Heritage tropical garden with orchid garden. Free entry, shaded paths, near Orchard Road.

pois.name: Bugis+
pois.description: Mall near Bugis MRT with anime, manga, and figure shops across several floors.

pois.name: Bugis Street Market
pois.description: Bustling street market with cheap clothes, accessories, and souvenirs. Haggling expected.

pois.name: Haji Lane
pois.description: Narrow street of indie boutiques, vintage shops, and street art in Kampong Glam.

pois.name: Kinokuniya (Ngee Ann City)
pois.description: Massive Japanese bookstore with huge manga section in English and Japanese.

pois.name: Science Centre Singapore
pois.description: Hands-on science museum with 1,000+ exhibits on physics, engineering, and space. Observatory on-site.
